products.title: Blue Buffalo Wilderness Chicken Recipe Adult High-Protein Grain-Free Dry Dog Food
products.description: Fuel your furry friend’s next adventure with Blue Buffalo Wilderness Chicken Recipe Adult High-Protein Grain-Free Dry Dog Food. Made with real chicken as the first ingredient, this natural food provides balanced nutrition to help your pup thrive while satisfying their wild side. With 34% protein, this grain-free formula contains fats, complex carbohydrates, fruits, and vegetables for wholesome, well-rounded nutrition without the grains some pet parents choose to avoid. The high-quality protein from deboned chicken helps your adult furbaby develop and maintain strong, healthy, lean muscles. Plus, all Blue Wilderness dry foods include exclusive antioxidant-rich LifeSource Bits, which help support immune system health. Crafted from the finest natural ingredients, enhanced with vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients. This recipe is made without chicken (or poultry) by-product meals, corn, wheat, or soy, and artificial flavors or preservatives, so you can feel good about feeding your furry family member this dry food.
